name: Maude

text.trigger: A survivor of yours searches the Grocery Store.
text.vignette: Behind the loading dock you find a pallet of canned goods nobody has touched, and a faded photo of someone named Maude pinned above it. Something about the place makes you want to leave quickly and quietly.

options.haul: Run the haul home at once: the searching survivor goes to the colony without a move roll and three food tokens are added.
options.stash: Pack two food cards for later and stay out a while longer.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1 card #6. Simplified: the printed card also bars playing food that turn.
